about.description: STOKR tokenizes fixed-income instruments and corporate bonds, enabling fractional secondary trading and yield generation. It bridges traditional debt markets with DeFi infrastructure.
about.registryInfo: STOKR (Stokr S.A., Luxembourg) - Luxembourg CSSF-supervised security-token issuance and trading venue. Founded 2018. Issues tokenized securities (equity, debt, real-estate) under EU MiFID II / Prospectus Regulation frameworks.

fees.revenueNotes: STOKR charges one-time issuance/listing fees, annual platform fees from issuers, and a small per-transaction trading fee. CSSF-supervised business model with limited public fee disclosure.
